headlines.title: Saylor says Strategy’s Bitcoin-heavy reserve capital surpasses nearly all S&P 500 financial firms
headlines.summary: Michael Saylor’s Strategy Inc has pulled ahead of almost every financial services giant in the S&P 500 on a key balance-sheet measure. Only Warren Buffett’s Berkshire Hathaway still ranks higher.

headlines.title: Strategy (MSTR) Looks Cheap As Bitcoin Buying Resumes With 4,603 More Coins
headlines.summary: Strategy (MSTR) has restarted Bitcoin purchases after a 10 week pause, adding 4,603 coins to reach holdings of 845,050. The move was funded by new share issuance and keeps attention on its Bitcoin centric treasury approach. Over the past month, Strategy’s stock has seen a sharp rebound, with a 30 day share price return of about 29.9%, even though the year to date share price return is down 21.6% and the 1 year total shareholder return is down 62.7%.

headlines.title: MicroStrategy Reserve Capital Beats All S&P 500 Financials But Berkshire, MSTR Still Slips
headlines.summary: MicroStrategy says its reserve capital beats every S&P 500 financial but Berkshire. Its own filing says $50.7 billion.

headlines.title: Bitcoin Climbed Back Above $80,000. Michael Saylor’s Strategy Isn’t Going to Zero, But Its Fate Rests on the Same Thing.
headlines.summary: Strategy Executive Chairman Michael Saylor has received a lifeline, but his company's fate is still tied to Bitcoin going up.

description: Strategy Inc, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a bitcoin treasury company in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and internationally. It offers investors varying degrees of economic exposure to Bitcoin by offering a range of securities, including equity and fixed income instruments. The company also provides AI-powered enterprise analytics software, including Strategy One, which provides non-technical users with the ability to directly access novel and actionable insights for decision-making. In addition, the company provides Strategy Mosaic, a universal intelligence layer that offers enterprises with consistent definitions and governance across data sources, regardless of where that data resides or which tools access it. The company was formerly known as MicroStrategy Incorporated and changed its name to Strategy Inc in August 2025. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia.
